title: Predicate category
description: The category over a predicate set Pi: objects are predicates; morphisms are generated by four classes -- specialization (a partial order p <= q), converse (an involution p -> p^op swapping subject/object roles), and subject/object projection (to the entity factors). The reindexing functors along these generators act on the fiber algebras A_p (the hyperdoctrine layer), each carrying existential/universal adjoints. This schema declares the generator data; the conversing / specializing / projecting-to-* morphisms verify the laws and emit the generated morphism pairs (e.g. converse-pairs).

converse.description: The involution p -> p^op on Pi (swap subject/object roles).

specialization.description: The specialization partial order as [p, q] pairs meaning p <= q.

subject-projection.description: Generator data for projection to the subject factor (derived with the cell-set reindexing).

object-projection.description: Generator data for projection to the object factor.

converse-pairs.description: Derived by conversing: the morphism pairs [p, p^op].

specialization-pairs.description: Derived by specializing: the reflexive-transitive closure of the specialization order as [p, q] pairs (p <= q).
